why: 0.79.0 (released, app is 0.80.0) still carries the 'Now they do' sound line while the author's own note beside it says not proven on his OPPO yet
help article 'ready-today-and-quick-workout' has no unreleased/onlyWhen flag so it is live, while the Workout tab no longer renders ReadyCard and nothing else routes to /ready or /quick
bestMatch slices hits to MAX_CHOICES=5 and the Chooser prints options.length as the count; matchMember sorts running plans first only AFTER the cut, so a running member past the fifth hit is lost too

on refund failure run() returns reason 'failed' with refunded=false; executeTask caches it in finished (so later taps replay it), the card keeps the same taskId, and after reload owner_ai_spend answers ALREADY_SPENT -> 'This was done already'; no server auto-refund exists

gymExportSheets writes only About/Members/Plans/Memberships/Payments/Check-ins/Enquiries/Expenses and the JSON copy is the CrmSnapshot (adds only workoutPlans); button says 'Download all your gym's data' though the line above it honestly lists members, plans, payments, check-ins
when() and exportFileBase() both use toISOString(), which is UTC, with no zone label

history lives under one fixed localStorage key 'mettleup_help_questions' with no gym or person in it, and nothing anywhere removes that key (sign-out only calls auth signOut); the delete request goes through the same sendFeedback
lengthFromPlanName's first regex takes '3 days' from '3 Days a Week Monthly' before the monthly word is ever checked; termFromRow uses it for a missing end date and as the new plan's length

a QR visit has no passCompany (server 0055 never stamps one), so passCompanyOfVisit reads the member's company and passSince today; passFields clears both on untick and restarts passSince=today on re-tick
alreadyRewarded matches the note line '(<friend name>)' across all the member's plans, so a second same-name friend skips extendMembership but rewardGiven is still written
same root as G-0055: name-keyed alreadyRewarded check skips the extend while the enquiry is marked rewarded
Print is disabled={unconfirmed} but the WhatsApp link is gated only on waHref && !offline, so it shows while the payment is still unconfirmed

PlanRequestsCard approve calls extendMembership with no freeze-permission check and Today renders it for owner and desk (comment says so, by design), while permissions set staff freeze:false and staffRightsWords says staff cannot freeze plans: the rule and the words disagree
for 'phone-and-account' deleteAccount runs first; if erase() then throws, the catch shows 'Nothing was deleted' though the account is gone

phoneAfterErase (the only caller) sits after discard() and the dashboard/chat refreshes in one try whose catch is empty, so any earlier throw skips reminders-off, Health Connect off and widget blanking without a log
